installCommand: set -e; SDK="$HOME/flutter-sdk"; if [ ! -x "$SDK/bin/flutter" ]; then rm -rf "$SDK"; git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$SDK"; fi; export PATH="$SDK/bin:$PATH"; flutter config --no-analytics --enable-web; echo "CWD=$(pwd)"; ls -la pubspec.yaml; flutter pub get
buildCommand: set -e; export PATH="$HOME/flutter-sdk/bin:$PATH"; echo "CWD=$(pwd)"; flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE=https://fctv33-api.kedidi-anis.workers.dev
